candidates.issues: Added 'קטן' (small) to the saucepan which wasn't in the source. Translated 'flaky sea salt' as 'coarse sea salt' (מלח ים גס), which is a common substitute but not perfectly accurate.
Added 'שוקולדיים' (chocolatey) to the title, which was not in the source. Also added 'קטן' (small) to the saucepan.
Very accurate and natural. Excellent translation of 'flaky sea salt' (פתיתי מלח ים).
Accurate, but 'מלח ים פתיתים' sounds slightly less natural than 'פתיתי מלח ים' in construct state.
Completely changed the title from 'Fudgy' to 'Rich and tender' (עשירים ונימוחים).
Contains a typo 'בסירית' instead of 'בסיר' or 'בסיר קטן'. Incorrect construct state 'שוקולד הצ׳יפס' instead of 'השוקולד צ'יפס' or 'נטיפי השוקולד'.
